visualCharacteristics: Grid of info teaser cards (image, tags, pretitle + title, optional text, read-more link; whole card is a link), 2-up by default.
contentPattern: One row per card: image, tag list (ul), h2 with pretitle title, optional text, link. A trailing row with only a short paragraph becomes the load-more control (6 more per click).
usage: News, stories and listing pages, plus related-content grids.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for article/story teaser grids and listings.
